body.statement: If \(B^{0,(a)}=0\) for every \(a\in M\), then every compatible order induces the same zero tuple. For an empty observed view graph, all \(p!\) orders are compatible, \(N_{\mathrm{out}}=1\), and the fragment algorithm retains exactly one fragment in every subset bucket \(H_A\), hence \(2^p\) fragments in total.
body.justification: The reduction verifies that the claimed quotient removes genuine factorial order multiplicity in the standard no-edge special case.
body.gap: Ordinary linear-extension and DAG enumeration methods still list structural witnesses in this case; the proposition records the required collapse to one numerical mechanism.
body.consumer: Implementers obtain a boundary regression test that detects accidental order enumeration or failure to intern identical zero rows.
